points.description: States that the queue is stored in a circular array (ring buffer), not a plain linear array.
Maintains separate front/head and rear/tail indices (or pointers) for the two ends of the queue.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if only one of the front or rear index/pointer is mentioned.

levels.says: Mentions only one end index/pointer, such as only a front or only a rear pointer.

points.description: Keeps the front of the queue toward the beginning of the array and the rear toward the end of the array.
Allows the rear pointer to wrap around from the end of the array back to the beginning, e.g. by using modulo/circular indexing.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if wrap-around is mentioned but not tied to the rear pointer.

levels.says: Mentions wrap-around or reuse of array positions but does not say that the rear pointer wraps.

rubric.notes: Full marks require a circular array, front and rear indices, the stated front/rear orientation, and rear-pointer wrap-around. Part marks are available for missing one of these elements, especially for mentioning only one pointer or only vague wrap-around. A plain array with shifting elements, or an answer with no wrap-around, does not earn the circular-array/rear-wrap marks.
